method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Customs Act 1960 (Singapore), 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation, version in force from 30 September 2026 (amendments to Act 16 of 2026), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/CA1960.txt.
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under the standing grant in SSO's Terms of Use cl.13 - see ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: SCOPED to the traveller crossing Singapore's border, one module. s 93 (declaring, the Red and Green Channels, deemed uncustomed goods, the Green Channel presumption, with the duty as a regulative rule), s 109 and s 93(5) (being searched, and what may be insisted on), s 129 (questions and the s 129(3) privilege), ss 128, 128B, 128E, 128I, 128J, 128KA, 129 and 136 (the offences a traveller or vehicle owner meets), s 128L (all five penalty scales, minimum and maximum fines in $, prison terms, deemed knowledge, specified offences), ss 115 and 115A (burden of proof, presumed possession), s 110(3), (4) (notice of seizure), s 124 (the one-month claim window), s 126(2) (release on composition), s 127 (costs and damages), s 119 (prison in default of a fine), ss 19 and 20 (refunds and short levies, with dates). Not encoded: Parts 2 to 11 otherwise, most of Part 12, Part 13 beyond ss 109 and 110(3), (4), ss 128A, 128C, 128D, 128F to 128H, 128K, 130 to 135, 137 onwards, and all subsidiary legislation. No duty rates, duty free allowances, list of compoundable offences or fuel order is deposited; each is an input.
seat: the traveller crossing Singapore's border (and, after a seizure, the owner of the goods or vehicle seized)
